proof.criterion: Review round 12 finding 1: a related_checks record retry that starts while shutdown's waitBackground is already waiting is counted by it and does not panic; the process exits cleanly
proof.surface: head server built from 2e275c88 (GOWORK=off go build ./cmd/dispatch) on rootless Postgres 17.11 + pgvector 0.8.0 (127.0.0.1:5433), fresh database per run; real SIGTERM to the server pid; the CLI built from this head (keyed create) and curl with no Idempotency-Key (unkeyed create)
proof.command: $TMPDIR/tester568/shut.sh: seed SHUT-1 and wait 20 s for its document to settle; psql tx1 'lock table issues in share mode' 14 s and tx2 'lock table asks in access exclusive mode' 40 s; at +0.5 s file 'Zymurgy ledger totals drift' (keyed via dispatch issue --force, or unkeyed via curl POST /api/v1/issues); at +1.0 s kill -TERM the server; read the server log, the client output and related_checks
proof.observed: Keyed: SIGTERM +1.0 s; 12:07:21.8 'settle documents with requests still in flight' (shutdown reached waitBackground about +12 s with the keyed handler still counted); the create committed at +14 s and answered not_made timeout ('No related-item check was made: … within 5s', 'Title overlaps you forced past: SHUT-1'); the record's first attempt failed and its retry started at 12:07:29.9, mid-wait, and logged 'related-item check not recorded rows=1 error="context canceled"'; deregistered 12:07:30.4; server exit 0 at +20.7 s; no panic in the log. Unkeyed: same sequence, HTTP 201 at +20.2 s, retry at 12:08:14.0 logged context canceled, deregistered 12:08:14.7, exit 0 at +20.9 s, no panic.
proof.negativeControl: The same unkeyed scenario on the pre-fix build (dc9071e6, sync.WaitGroup) also exits 0 with no panic and the same log: the sync.WaitGroup misuse the review named is a race too narrow to show on a real server, so the real-surface run confirms the fixed behaviour and does not tell the two builds apart; the fix is judged by reading backgroundWork (server.go: start/done/wait allow work to start while wait waits) and goDetached at suggestions.go:863.

TestRelatedCheckRecordRetryStartedWhileShutdownWaitsIsWaitedFor (related_check_test.go:497-557) asserts the retried row is written once the lock is released; a real shutdown cancels lifetime before waitBackground, so the retry is cancelled at once and the row is dropped with a log line. The behaviour matches the code's own comment and loses only a statistics row during a shutdown under lock contention; the test's final assertion describes a state shutdown never reaches. For the reviewer to judge.
